title: Seller Feedback and Product Review Disputes — Seller Performance Standing Rules
content:
**Rule.** A seller may dispute seller feedback or a product review no later than the feedback dispute window counted in calendar days from the date the feedback or review was left, and may submit no more disputes in a calendar month than the level's monthly allowance. Seller feedback is removed only for a reason in the feedback removable reasons that the records support; negative feedback about the delivery of a Fulfilled by Northloop order is removed under "Fulfilled by Northloop fulfillment experience". A product review is removed only for a reason in the product review removable reasons; a review that is merely unfavourable is never removed. Removing negative seller feedback removes its defect; product reviews never carry defects.

## The two limits on disputing

- **Window.** The window runs in calendar days from the date the feedback or review was left; a dispute is in time when submitted no later than the window's last day.
- **Monthly allowance.** The disputes counted against a month's allowance are all the seller's disputes created in the calendar month of the handling date, withdrawn ones included. The allowance is the one set for the seller's current Seller Performance Standing level.

## What a removal does

| Item removed after a dispute | Effect on the seller's standing |
|---|---|
| Negative seller feedback | the feedback is removed, and its negative feedback defect on that order is removed with the reason "feedback removed" |
| Seller feedback that is not negative | the feedback is removed; no defect is involved |
| A product review | the review is removed; product reviews never carry defects |

Each removal is recorded on the standing record with the feedback or review reference, whether it was seller feedback or a product review, the order it belongs to (blank for a product review), the rating of removed feedback and the dispute that led to it.

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. Negative seller feedback complains only that a Fulfilled by Northloop order arrived late. It is removed under "Fulfilled by Northloop fulfillment experience", and the order's negative feedback defect is removed.
2. A product review rates the product poorly with no removable reason. It is merely unfavourable and is never removed.
3. A seller whose monthly allowance is 5 has created 4 disputes this month and withdrawn one of them. All 4 count; one more dispute may be submitted this month.
